enabled.name: Send to my PC
enabled.hint: Send this browser's chat, rolls, combat turns and your character's state to the D&D Table Assistant running on this computer. Off by default; only turn it on in your own browser.

port.name: Assistant port
port.hint: The port the assistant's hub listens on (127.0.0.1). Default 8765.

token.name: Assistant token
token.hint: Paste the token printed by `dnd-assistant token --show`.

DNDA.noCharacter: D&D Table Assistant: no character is assigned to your user, so character state won't be sent.
